title: Scp-409 The Crystal
style: harsh direct on-camera flash photograph at night, red-eye effect, overexposed foreground, pitch black background beyond the flash, evidence photo, film grain, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: Dr Gears
credit.line: Based on SCP-409 by Dr Gears - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-409 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: One touch, and three hours later you are turning to crystal. Would you have noticed in time?

Hero.look: Short dark hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen only from behind, no face visible.

scenes.image_prompt: Wide harsh flash photograph of a dark containment room, far away a pale translucent glassy quartz crystal, five feet tall, in an open granite case on a white plinth, huge empty black area above. {style}

lines.text: Day one. They dug it out from under shards several feet deep, and many of the diggers were lost. It looks like plain quartz, five feet tall.

scenes.label: DAY 2
scenes.image_prompt: Harsh flash photograph of a concrete floor, a dropped glove crusted with white glassy crystal veins, a few tiny quartz shards glittering, the dark behind it unlit, no crystal pillar in frame. {style}

lines.text: Day two. But touch it, and three hours later you begin to crystallize, inch by inch, with pain like frostbite.

scenes.label: DAY 3
scenes.image_prompt: Harsh flash photograph of a concrete wall with clear quartz shards embedded and a long scrape dragged along it, glittering fragments on the floor, far at the dark edge a faint pale crystal glint. {style}

lines.text: Day three. And then the body creaks for twenty minutes, bursts into thousands of shards, and each shard spreads it again.

scenes.label: DAY 4
scenes.image_prompt: Flash-lit dark room, a grey granite case open on a white plinth, a small pale glassy translucent quartz crystal, five feet tall, standing inside it, the rest of the room unlit black. {style}

lines.text: Day four. Only granite stops it, so it stands inside a granite case, and nothing else in the world is trusted to hold it.

scenes.label: DAY 5
scenes.image_prompt: Harsh flash photograph from a doorway down a dark corridor, sealed granite containers in the foreground, far away a pale translucent quartz crystal in its granite case, half hidden in shadow. {style}

lines.text: Day five. So nobody touches it, anything that does is quarantined, and even the tools that moved its residue go into granite too.

scenes.label: DAY 6
scenes.image_prompt: Harsh flash photograph of a torn dark jacket sleeve on the floor, white glassy crystal crusting its cuff, far behind it a pale translucent quartz crystal half hidden by a granite case, black dark around. {style}

lines.text: Day six. But I was tired, and my sleeve brushed the crystal. Three hours, I told myself. Plenty of time.

scenes.label: DAY 7
scenes.image_prompt: Harsh flash photograph, closer, a pale glassy translucent quartz crystal five feet tall in its open granite case, fine cracks across its facets, white plinth, mostly black darkness around. {style}

lines.text: Day seven. My hand burns like frost, and I can hear creaking. It already happened.

scenes.image_prompt: Very close harsh flash photograph, out of focus, jagged edge of a pale translucent glassy quartz crystal, granite case rim in foreground, lit by one cold light, deep darkness around, nobody touching it. {style}

lines.text: Do not look away from the screen, and stay exactly where you are.

archivist_note: TAPE 13  -  I played it twice. The narrator paused in new places.
